mentions.name: Modelmathics
mentions.description: An interactive course for learning how LLMs work by building one from scratch. Learners start from an empty Python file and write the model themselves — a tokenizer, a bigram model, attention, and a Transformer — with tests validating each step before progressing. At the end, published open weights run on the learner's own code. Stage 1 (11 lessons) is live as a free private beta, delivered via a terminal app (mm) with the learner's code kept in local files.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wanted to understand how LLMs really work, so I’m building Modelmathics (https://modelmathics.com) and doing every lesson myself as I go.

You start from an empty Python file and write the model yourself: a tokenizer, a bigram model, attention, a Transformer. At the end, published open weights run on your own code. Tests check each step before you move on.
